purpose: Defines the authoritative runtime boundary for Adaptive Research. Other simulation workstreams exchange normalized facts/events and consume capabilities/view models; they do not directly mutate hidden research graph internals.
initialization_pipeline: load one base-era fragment and selected historically justified fragments
merge node states, competence, traits, capabilities, institutions, pressure/evidence/tacit seeds under starting-profile rules
materialize only legitimately visible starting candidates from prerequisite/evidence/pressure/applicability indexes

external_input_events.payload: metric id, normalized value, context, observation confidence where relevant
external_input_events.effect: updates only indexed Research Pressure rules

external_input_events.payload: event type, context, severity, evidence/provenance refs
external_input_events.effect: updates pressure/evidence and wakes only indexed candidates
stores evidence and wakes indexed candidates/foreign assessments

external_input_events.payload: institution/facility capacity added, removed, damaged, restored
external_input_events.effect: updates eligible lab/facility pools and blocker/readiness state
wakes only trait-indexed candidates and rechecks population-scoped capabilities

external_input_events.payload: declared research deployment event id + context
knowledge/physical/package/expert asset acquired, lost, damaged, transferred
external_input_events.effect: updates tacit readiness, evidence, foreign-tech assessment, brokerage state
creates evidence/pressure without exposing hidden implementation

external_queries.input: civilization + capability id + optional target context
external_queries.rule: never require callers to know which technology supplied the capability

external_queries.output: research/operational/dependency/hazard/assimilation assessment based only on legitimate knowledge
eligible free effective lab capacity plus directed-program availability

project_progress_pipeline: verify node remains visible/investigable and directed-program slot exists
verify minimum eligible assigned Effective Research Labs
verify hard stage requirements such as facilities/evidence/material access
compute stage-relevant Project Readiness from competence/facility/evidence/tacit inputs
apply lab diminishing-return curve and readiness efficiency to generated RP
resolve only contextually permitted setback/hypothesis outcomes with campaign-seeded deterministic uncertainty
on state transition emit compact research-state event
on Mature apply node capabilities plus validated technology/deployment grants

cross_workstream_ownership.adaptive_research_owns: research state, graph, emergence, project progression, competence, foreign-tech interpretation, research-facing facilities/capabilities, view-model semantics
cross_workstream_ownership.construction_economy_owns: physical construction cost/time/upkeep/damage of research institutions and supplied industrial assets
cross_workstream_ownership.population_species_owns: biological/population facts that map to applicability contexts
cross_workstream_ownership.exploration_intelligence_owns: how observations/evidence/foreign assets are legitimately obtained
cross_workstream_ownership.UI_implementation_owns: rendering/interactions that consume the research view-model contract
